product_summary: macrosys.in (Macrosys Corporation, Plot No R-20 Surjeet Mahal, 1st Floor, Chandigarh Hospital Road, Megraj Colony, Hanumangarh Junction, Rajasthan 335512) is a software development and IT services firm, not a hardware/electronics manufacturer. Real product line per its own site: 'Maccy' GST accounting & inventory software (v1.0/1.1, priced 8500–25000 INR), 'Perfect Cargo' 4.2 transport/booking software (7000–10000 INR), 'Greewer' (per-unit 0.25–0.45 + setup), e-commerce online shopping portal (2500–65000 INR), MLM software portal (19500–155000 INR), WhatsApp API and GST API access (0.15–0.45 per unit), digital marketing, PAN/Income-tax/GST return filing services (800–25000 INR), plus downloadable Excel utilities (MacrosysGSTR1CompuTax.xlsx, GSTR_4_Utility_v2.3.xls, GSTR1 Excel Workbook Template, GSTR2 Comput-Tax template), SQL installer / report viewer / pre-installer packages. Also offers full-cycle mobile app development, web design, Android app development, industry-specific software for healthcare, retail/e-commerce, finance, travel, media. No physical electronic goods, no components, no machines, no electrical apparatus of any kind are listed anywhere on the site.
comment: HS 854370 covers 'electrical machines and apparatus having individual functions, not specified elsewhere' — i.e. physical electrical/electronic hardware. Nothing on macrosys.in corresponds to it: the company sells software licences, SaaS/API access, downloadable Excel utilities and IT development services. Correct classification is software (852349 if delivered on physical media) or, predominantly, service codes under heading 9983 (998431/998439 IT services, 998313 support). Industry label 'IT и электроника' is a misclassification on the 'electronics' half — this is pure IT/software services, no electronics trade. Trader signs: the site resells third-party components (Microsoft .NET 3.5, SQL Server 2005, Report Viewer, TeamViewer, UltraViewer, MS Management Studio) as prerequisites, and sells API access (WhatsApp/GST) rather than owning the infrastructure — i.e. reseller/integrator, not manufacturer. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: accounting/ERP software, transport software, e-commerce and MLM portals, API resale, GST/tax filing services, digital marketing. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company is retained and the code is corrected to the factual one. All product facts above are from the company's own website (macrosys.in home, /pricing, /downloads) — no customs line was available to me in this task, so the actual export/import classification remains 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note also: the claimed contact person 'SUSHIL SACHDEV' does not appear anywhere on the public site (no /about-us or /contact-us page resolves — both return HTTP 404), so the ownership/contact claim is unverified; no CIN, PAN, GSTIN or revenue data is public on the site and none is asserted here.
